latestVersion.changelog:
Follow-builders 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Delivers AI builders digest: summarizes updates from top AI product creators on Twitter/X and YouTube podcasts into easy-to-read digests.
- Fully local; requires no paid APIs (uses free Rettiwt-API for Twitter and yt-dlp for YouTube).
- Guided onboarding process covers language, lookback window, and custom source management.
- Users can customize tracked accounts, podcasts, and blogs at any time via simple commands.
- Digest runs summarize new Tweets, podcast transcripts, and blog posts—output supports English, Chinese, or bilingual modes.
- Configuration and source management are accessible through a CLI or conversation—no manual file editing needed.
